title: Ledger Reading Note on the Day the Studio Clock for a Quote Starts
content:
# Ledger Reading Note on the Day the Studio Clock for a Quote Starts

Three dates can start the studio's clock for a quote on a commission under Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions: the date the design was approved, the date of the consultation the commission was opened at, and the date the metal price behind the quote was taken. Which of them starts it turns on whether the design stands approved, on whether a deposit has been received, and on whether a design fee stands booked on the commission.

## The three cases

1. Where the design stands approved on the commission and a deposit has been received, the studio's clock for the quote starts on the date the design was approved.
2. Where the design does not stand approved and a design fee stands booked on the commission, the studio's clock for the quote starts on the date the commission was opened at the consultation.
3. Otherwise the studio's clock for the quote starts on the date the metal price behind the quote was taken.

## What each reading is taken from

| Reading | Taken from |
|---|---|
| Does the design stand approved? | The date the customer approved the design, as it stands on the commission; the design stands approved where that date stands, and does not where it is empty |
| Has a deposit been received? | The deposit entries booked to the commission; a deposit has been received where at least one stands |
| Does a design fee stand booked? | The commission's own entries under the design fee reason; one stands booked where at least one such entry has been made |
| The three dates themselves | The date the design was approved, the date of the consultation the commission was opened at, and the date the metal price behind the quote was taken, all on the commission record |

## Dated readings (hypothetical)

A commission opened at a consultation on the 3rd of February, whose quote was built on a metal price taken on the 10th of February, and whose design was approved on the 1st of March.

| What stands on the commission | The clock starts |
|---|---|
| The design approved and one deposit received | The 1st of March |
| No design approval date, one design fee entry booked | The 3rd of February |
| No design approval date and no design fee entry | The 10th of February |
| The design approved but no deposit received, and no design fee entry | The 10th of February |
